raw_segments.text: "'Kamael est droll,' Mariette said to herself, and when she went downstairs she told the
head housemaid about it. But she had already begun to like this odd little girl who had
such an intelligent, small face and such perfect manners. She had taken care of children before
who were not so polite. Sarah was a very fine little person and had a gentle, appreciative
way of saying, "'If you please, Mariette, thank you, Mariette,' which was very charming."
Mariette told the head housemaid that she thanked her as if she was thanking a lady.
